description.zh: 成员账号ID。该参数仅适用于多账号检测模式。
description.en: The ID of the member account. This parameter is applicable only to the multi-account check pattern.

description.zh:
需要获取不合规资源的检测项ID。

您可以调用[ListEvaluationMetadata](~~2841889~~)接口，获取检测项ID。
description.en:
The ID of the check item for which you want to retrieve non-compliant resources.

You can call the [ListEvaluationMetadata](~~2841889~~) operation to obtain the check item ID.

description.zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。默认值：5。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return in a single request. Default value: 5.
The token for the next query.

description.zh:
治理成熟度检测范围。取值：

- Account（默认）：查询当前账号的检测项明细。
- ResourceDirectory：查询资源目录所有成员账号的检测项明细。操作前，需要先升级至多账号治理成熟度检测。
description.en:
The scope of the governance maturity check. Valid values:

- Account (default): queries the check item details for the current account.
- ResourceDirectory: queries the check item details for all member accounts in the resource directory. Before using this value, upgrade to multi-account governance maturity check.

title.zh: 获取指定检测项的不合规资源信息
title.en: Retrieve non-compliant resource information for a specified check item
